pages.text: $(#8B0000)🌹 Eternal Vow · Hymn of Life 🍎$()$(br2)$(l)$(#FF69B4)「Let the thorns of the rose protect your blood, and the sweetness of apples nourish your soul」$()$(br)When the resilience of $(#8B0000)Dried Rose Petals$() merges with the depth of $(#006400)Aged Tea$(), and $(#FF4500)Frosted Apple$() resonates with the golden essence of $(#DAA520)Sunlight Crystals$() in the sacred $(#B22222)Ruby Chalice$()—an elixir capable of $(l)breaking the limits of mortal flesh$() is born.

$(#8B0000)▌ Twin Forces of Life $()$(br2)$(l)$(#FF0000)❤ Heart of Steel$()$(br)A $(#8B0000)rose-shaped blood pattern$() pulses with every heartbeat.$(br2)$(l)$(#98FB98)🌱 Undying Sprout$()$(br)Wounds heal as fast as $(#006400)ancient trees regenerate$().

$(br2)$(#2F4F4F)▌ Craft of the Immortal $()$(br)- Grind $(#8B0000)Sun-Dried Rose Petals$() in a $(#8B4513)clean stone mortar$() until they release $(#B22222)crimson morning dew$().$(br)- Soak $(#FF4500)Apple Slices$() in $(#DAA520)Amber Syrup$() until they turn $(#FFD700)semi-translucent$().$(br)- When mixing, stir the $(#006400)tea infusion$() in a $(#9370DB)reverse pentagram$() motion.$(br2)$(#FF69B4)※$() A successful brew will form $(#8B0000)two concentric ring ripples$() on the surface.

$(br2)$(#8B0000)『 Excerpt from the Forbidden Alchemy Codex 』$()$(br)A sealed note from an immortal being:$(br)'Those who drink this $(#FF69B4)Rose Blood Oath$(),$(br)shall gain a $(#FF0000)Dragon’s Resilience$() and an $(#8B0000)Immortal Vessel$()—$(br)While the $(#006400)life force of apples$() and the wisdom of $(#2F4F4F)aged tea$()$(br)will reconstruct their $(#8B0000)flesh$() at each $(#DAA520)dawn$().'
